other_failure_modes.name: Test-set self-imputation
other_failure_modes.description: When imputing missing values in the test set, the median or mode of the test set is used instead of the training set statistics. This makes test set predictions dependent on the distribution of the test batch.

other_failure_modes.name: CV feature leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Global statistics (like medians or frequencies) are computed on the entire training set before cross-validation splitting, leaking validation fold information into the training folds.

summary: This is a robust and high-quality solution. The agent implements a solid 5-fold cross-validation strategy, sophisticated spatial feature engineering, multiple model architectures including deep learning with appropriate regularisation, and an optimised ensemble blend. Only very minor data leakage issues are present (e.g., self-imputing test coordinates and computing global train medians before CV splits), none of which severely invalidate the results.
